title: Hitachi at SemEval-2023 Task 3: Exploring Cross-lingual Multi-task Strategies for Genre and Framing Detection in Online News
reasoning: The paper evaluates model performance on subtasks that include the detection of 'Morality' and 'Fairness and equality' frames within news articles across multiple languages. This involves benchmarking how language models identify and categorize content related to moral and ethical perspectives.
